articles.summary: Okta can't natively manage apps that don't support SAML or OIDC - and in most enterprise environments, that's roughly 30% of the app estate. This post breaks down the three approaches for closing that gap: Okta SWA, automated password managers, and SSO bridging platforms.
articles.title: How to Manage Non-SAML Apps in Okta

articles.summary: Most Okta UAR workflows leave non-SSO apps to spreadsheets and manual follow-ups. Here's how to automate access reviews for banking portals, legacy tools, and every app outside your IDP.
articles.title: How to Automate User Access Reviews for Non-SSO Apps in Okta
